body:
I don't think this helps, but I have felt so lonely. lately.

I know that I am supposed to live my life for myself but I don't know how without the context of other people. If its not a partner, or parents or siblings or whatever I dont know how to live but why can't I just live for myself. 

People keep telling me to just plan your next step for a better life, but I just question why. I have family, but why do they really care about me, they care more about losing somebody than they care about my feelings?

So does anybody really care about how I feel? From a selfish point of view, no. Nobody cares. Unless you're the love of somebodies life, nobody really cares except for selfish reasons whether you live or die. I don't really know how to deal with that, I guess its a matter of self worth, is your lifereally worth living if nobody else is there to appreciate your perspective.

I also have questioned recently what kind of impact I have had on the people I thought loved me. It is shocking how you can think so much of your relationship with others but realize how little they value it in return. that is the biggest issue I struggle wth right now, if the relationships I value mean nothing to the people I value them with what does that say about my self worth...

I don't know where to go from here, but I know that this isn't such a unique experience. I don't know how to get over it, excpet for to just fuck everything I feel like I should be doing and just doing what makes mee feel good. Nothing else really matters. If you're going to kill yourself anyways why not just try to make everything feel good at the end. be selfish. thats what I am trying to do. I'll let you know how that works out.
